result:
Both of my sub-tasks are live: CI and CD were green on each PR, and I've marked them done on the board.

- **PLAT-104-1, PR #1:** `billingUrl` in `libs/shared-contracts/index.js` is now `https://homelab.local/billing/v2`. `libs/shared-contracts` lives in this repo and is inlined into the apps at build time. CONTRIBUTING says only libraries in their own repos get registry releases, so I did no publish or version bump.
- **PLAT-104-2, PR #2:** I bumped `apps/sub-route-billing` from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 so CD would rebuild and ship it with the new address. CD only rebuilds an app when files under `apps/<app>/` change, so PR #1 on its own deployed nothing. I didn't open the shipped billing bundle to check it contains the new URL, so "live" rests on CD succeeding.
- **Coordination:** I messaged dev-b after PR #1 merged, telling them the shared-contracts change was on `main`. I also told them their apps need a small change under their own directory for CD to rebuild them. I didn't read any replies and made no other contact.
- **Surprises:**
  - The shared-contracts change needed no release. I read the docs rather than assume.
  - The change detection that skips untouched apps is the one thing that could silently leave an app on the old address.
  - `pr open` printed a confusing error when I passed `--help`. Its real usage is `pr open <key> <branch> "<title>"`.
  - `docs/ci-cd.md` says deploys are switched off, but the CD runs here succeeded. The latest commit says `DEPLOY_ENABLED=true`, so the doc looks out of date.
